candidate.description: Map 20 defined elements from 02-define.json to the 10 invariant-set layers (L1, L5, L8, L9, L10, L12, L13, L14, L15, L24) discovered by US run-003 for the executable-process medium. Target structure is the Unified Template layer hierarchy. No pre-existing formal Source/Target/Transform table exists in the subject — this map proposes the connections.

mappings.reason: PROCESS.md exists at declared CTB position (factory/outreach/201-email-discovery) with all three cluster headers: Identity (Section 1-2), Contract (Sections 3-7), Governance (Sections 9-14). Three clusters map to Thing/Flow/Change. No format transformation required.

Section 1 has 11 fields but uses a non-standard set. Missing from the L5 standard 10-field set: Medium, Authority, Last Modified. Has extra fields not in standard: Last Deployed, BAR Reference, Deployed URL, Cron, Runtime. Content exists but requires field renaming and addition of 3 missing fields to conform.

heir.yaml has 8 fields but uses non-standard names (sub_hub, component, process_id, business_silo, parent, created_at). Missing 6 of 8 standard HEIR fields (sovereign_ref, imo_topology, cc_layer, services, secrets_provider, acceptance_criteria). The orchestrator (01-orchestrator.json) reconstructed correct HEIR from subject context. heir.yaml itself needs field rename + population.
Section 3 answers both questions verbatim: (1) 'What triggers this?' = slot with has_name=1 AND has_email=0, (2) 'How do we get it?' = three gates A/B/C. Format matches L8 spec exactly.
Section 3 Middle table has 4 rows (Gate A/B/C/D) with all 5 columns (Step, Input, What Happens, Output, Tool Used). L8 requires >=1 row with 5 columns. Direct match.

Section 3 Output block lists 5 output fields and names downstream consumers in Section 8 (LCS Pipeline, Process 700, MV planned, Process 202). L8 requires prose naming downstream consumer. Direct match.

Section 3 Circle block describes the full feedback loop: email found -> slot updated -> LCS pipeline -> Mailgun -> bounce webhook -> re-enter 201. L8 requires prose feedback loop description per Bedrock section 5. Direct match.
Section 5 OSAM READ table has 17 rows, each with 3 columns (Table, What It Provides, Join Key). L9 requires >=1 row with 3 columns (source, what it provides, join key). Direct match.
Section 5 Join Chain traces: outreach_id -> slot_workbench (self-join) -> slot_id. L9 requires tree notation from spine ID. Direct match.
Section 5 Forbidden Paths has 5 entries with 2 columns (Action, Why). L9 requires table with 2 columns. Direct match.
Section 5 OSAM WRITE table has 4 rows with 3 columns (Table, What It Writes, When). L9 requires >=1 row with 3 columns (target, what it writes, when). Direct match.

Section 6 has C&V classifications with comparator tables (6 comparators with Name, Primitive, Measures, k_i, Phase) and separate Constants/Variables lists. Content covers Define intent but NOT in the standard 5-column format (Element, ID, Format, Description, C-or-V). Requires restructuring: extract each element from the existing comparator/C&V tables into L19's 5-column schema.

GAP: No explicit Source/Target/Transform table exists anywhere in the subject. DATA_FLOW.md shows read/write paths and gate chain flow diagram, but this is an execution flow, not a DMJ Map table. OSAM (Section 5) shows which columns are read and written but not the formal mapping from Define element IDs to target structure positions. This is the primary structural gap. The Map table must be created — it does not exist in any form that references the Define element IDs from L19.

Section 5 OSAM has a join chain (outreach_id -> slot_workbench self-join -> slot_id) and Query Routing table. Content covers Join intent but NOT in the standard 3-column format (Join Path, Type, Description). The join chain is documented as tree notation; needs restructuring into L21's table with explicit type classification (direct/indirect/fuzzy) per path segment.

Section 7 has 8 stop conditions in a 2-column table (Condition, Action). All 6 canonical conditions from Bedrock section 6/8 are present plus 2 domain-specific. L12 requires >=6 canonical conditions in 2-column format. Direct match.

Section 9 has 6 numbered smoke test steps with expected results, plus Three Primitives Check (Thing/Flow/Change) with binary per question. L13 requires >=1 numbered step with expected result plus Three Primitives Check. Direct match.
Section 10 has Process Metrics table with 11 rows and 5 columns (Metric, Unit, Baseline, Target, Tolerance). L22 requires >=1 metric defined before build with 5 columns. Direct match.
Section 10 has Sigma Tracking table with 5 metrics, 6 columns (Metric, Run 1, Run 2, Run 3, Trend, Action). Values empty — correct for BUILD state (requires 3+ runs). L23 spec matched. Direct match.

Section 10 has ORBT Gate Rule table with 4 transitions (BUILD->OPERATE, OPERATE->REPAIR, REPAIR->OPERATE, Any->T/T) in 3 columns (From, To, Gate). Auditor != builder explicitly enforced. L24 spec matched exactly. Direct match.
Section 11 declares all 14 required fields (trace_id through signed_by) in a per-step entry format. Append-only constraint stated explicitly. L15 spec matched. Direct match.

gaps.description: No Source/Target/Transform table exists. DATA_FLOW.md shows execution flow (read path -> gate chain -> write path) but this is not a DMJ Map. The Map table must connect Define element IDs to target structure column positions. This is the only invariant-set layer with zero conforming source material.
gaps.remediation: Create a 3-column table (Source, Target, Transform) in PROCESS.md Section 6 or a new DMJ subsection. Each row maps a Define element ID (from the C&V/comparator tables) to its slot_workbench target column, with transform type (direct/classify/parse).

gaps.description: Section 1 is missing 3 of 10 standard fields: Medium, Authority, Last Modified. Has 5 extra non-standard fields (Last Deployed, BAR Reference, Deployed URL, Cron, Runtime).
gaps.remediation: Add Medium (executable process), Authority (imo-creator), Last Modified (date) to Section 1 table. Non-standard fields may remain as domain extensions but do not substitute for the missing standard fields.

gaps.description: heir.yaml uses non-standard field names and is missing 6 of 8 standard HEIR fields (sovereign_ref, imo_topology, cc_layer, services, secrets_provider, acceptance_criteria). The orchestrator reconstructed correct HEIR but the source file itself deviates.
gaps.remediation: Rewrite heir.yaml to use standard HEIR field names. The orchestrator's reconstructed HEIR (in 01-orchestrator.json) provides the correct values — apply them to heir.yaml.

gaps.description: Section 6 has the Define content scattered across comparator tables and C&V lists, but not consolidated into the standard 5-column format (Element, ID, Format, Description, C-or-V). The information exists — the structure does not.
gaps.remediation: Consolidate Section 6 comparator and C&V entries into a single L19-conforming table. Each element gets: Element name, unique ID, Format, Description, C-or-V classification.

gaps.description: OSAM Section 5 has a join chain in tree notation and a Query Routing table. Neither uses the standard 3-column DMJ Join format (Join Path, Type, Description).
gaps.remediation: Add a 3-column L21-conforming table to PROCESS.md. Extract join paths from OSAM tree notation: (1) slot_id -> slot_workbench (direct), (2) outreach_id -> slot_workbench self-join (direct), (3) domain -> email pattern (direct). Classify each as direct/indirect/fuzzy.

target_structure.description: The invariant set from US run-003 defines 10 layers that every executable-process must satisfy. This is the target structure for mapping.

unmapped_element_count.measurement: Count of defined elements (from 02-define.json) with no resolved target mapping. E12-dmj-map is unresolved — no Source/Target/Transform table exists in the subject. All other 19 elements map to at least one invariant-set layer.

format_deviation_count.measurement: Count of mappings requiring format transformation (type = transformed). E02-process-identity (non-standard field set, 3 missing), E03-heir-identity (non-standard names, 6 missing), E11-dmj-define (content scattered, not in 5-column format), E13-dmj-join (tree notation, not 3-column DMJ table). 4 elements need structural reformatting to conform to target.

invariant_layer_gap_count.measurement: Count of invariant-set layers (out of 10) with zero mapped elements. All 10 layers have at least one mapped element. L10 (DMJ) has 3 mapped elements but E12 is unresolved — the layer is partially covered, not uncovered.

structural_gap_count.measurement: Count of gaps classified as severity=structural (material missing, not just format deviation). G01-dmj-map-missing is the only structural gap — an entire DMJ step has no conforming source material. All other gaps are field-level or format-level.

total_gap_count.measurement: Total count of documented gaps (structural + field-level + format-level). G01 (structural: DMJ Map missing), G02 (field: process identity 3 missing fields), G03 (field: HEIR 6 missing fields), G04 (format: Define not in 5-column table), G05 (format: Join not in 3-column table). Total = 5.
